breakdown.description: The given relative velocities/angles imply different axial components, contradicting the statement that axial velocity is constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly resolves the inconsistency by dropping the given W2=100 m/s and instead computing the axial velocity from inlet conditions (Va = W1·cos(β1)) and then deriving W2 from the constant axial velocity and β2 (W2 = Va/cos(β2)). This matches the ground truth approach exactly, yielding W2 ≈ 122.5 m/s rather than the contradictory 100 m/s.
